header.running_head: The Sahabah (RA) Prefer the Pleasure of Rasulullaah ﷺ to their Own Pleasure

blocks.text: Ansaar immediately acceded saying, "If it pleases Rasulullaah ﷺ, you may have him." Hadhrat Umar (RA) took him in his custody and when Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) was with him, Hadhrat Umar (RA) said to him, "Accept Islaam, O Abbaas. I swear by Allaah that your accepting Islaam would please me more than (my father) Khattaab accepting Islaam. This is only because I know that your accepting Islaam would please Rasulullaah ﷺ."[^1]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Umar (RA) once said to Hadhrat Abbaas (RA), "Accept Islaam, O Abbaas. I swear by Allaah that your accepting Islaam would please me more than (my father) Khattaab accepting Islaam. I am saying this only because I know that Rasulullaah ﷺ would like you to be amongst the early ones to accept Islaam."[^2]

Hadhrat Sha'bi reports that when Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) was pressurising Hadhrat Umar (RA) for something, he said, "O Ameerul Mu'mineen! Tell me. How would you treat the uncle of Moosa (AS) if he came to you as a Muslim?" "By Allaah!" exclaimed Hadhrat Umar (RA), "I would certainly treat him well." "Well," remarked Hadhrat Abbaas (RA), "I am the uncle of Muhammad the Nabi ﷺ." Hadhrat Umar (RA) then said, "What do you think, O Abu Fadhl (do you think that I have no regard for you)? I swear by Allaah that your father is more beloved to me than my own father." "Really, do you swear by Allaah?" Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) staggered. "Really," replied Hadhrat Umar (RA), "and that is because I know that Rasulullaah ﷺ liked your father more than my father. I shall give preference to what Rasulullaah ﷺ liked over that which I like."[^3]

Hadhrat Muhammad bin Ali narrates that Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) once approached Hadhrat Umar (RA) saying, "Rasulullaah ﷺ had apportioned the land of Bahrain for me." "Who else knows about this?" asked Hadhrat Umar (RA). "Mughiera bin Shu'ba does," replied Hadhrat Abbaas (RA). Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) then brought Hadhrat Mughiera (RA), who testified on his behalf. However, Hadhrat Umar (RA) did not pass judgement in Hadhrat Abbaas (RA)'s favour, apparently not accepting his evidence. Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) then said some harsh words to Hadhrat Umar (RA), upon which Hadhrat Umar (RA) said (to Hadhrat Abbaas (RA)'s son), "O Abdullaah! Take your father's hand. O Abul Fadhl (Hadhrat Abbaas (RA)'s title) I swear by Allaah that I was happier by your accepting Islaam than if (my father) Khattaab had accepted Islaam because this pleased Rasulullaah ﷺ."[^4]
